_comment: Crafting outcome + XP tuning (see include/Crafting.h). Consumable outcome quality = scaling.base + quality_per_stat*craftStat + a luck roll in [0, quality_luck], clamped to quality_max. XP feeds the recipe's stat INVERSE to mastery: factor = clamp(xp_reach_gain*quality - xp_mastery_falloff*craftStat + 1, xp_floor, xp_ceiling), so reaching above your level pays more and routine work pays little. Coefficients only; the math lives in code. Placeholder values -- tune when the craft act lands. Tunable -- edit + relaunch (dev reads assets from source).
